summary: S&P Global Inc. operates as a leading provider of transparent ratings, benchmarks, analytics, and data to capital and commodity markets worldwide, functioning through four distinct reportable segments. The Ratings segment offers credit ratings and research to investors, corporations, governments, and financial institutions, while Market Intelligence provides data, analytics, and third-party research specifically to investment managers, banks, and corporations. Platts supplies benchmark prices and market data to producers, traders, and intermediaries within the energy, metals, and agriculture sectors, and the Indices segment maintains various indices to generate asset-linked fees for investors directing funds into ETFs and mutual funds. The company serves its global customer base through both third-party and proprietary distribution channels. The provided summaries do not describe the collection, use, or sharing of customer data.

Amphenol Corporation designs, manufactures, and markets electrical, electronic, fiber optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors, and specialty cables through two primary reporting segments: Interconnect Products and Assemblies, which serves automotive, aerospace, industrial, military, and mobile markets; and Cable Products and Solutions, which primarily targets broadband communications and information technology. Key products include fiber optic and power interconnects, backplane systems, cable assemblies, and sensors. The company operates globally, shipping products to customers located worldwide, with net sales based on the customer location of the final product shipment. Its customer base includes original equipment manufacturers, electronic manufacturing services, original design manufacturers, and communication network operators across approximately 70 countries. Sales to Apple Inc. accounted for about 11% of net sales in 2015, while distributors represented 12% of sales. The company competes against firms such as TE Connectivity, Molex, and Commscope. Neither segment summary mentions the collection, use, or sharing of customer data.

Moody's Corporation operates through two reportable segments, Moody's Investors Service and Moody's Analytics, serving distinct global markets. Moody's Investors Service provides credit ratings on debt obligations issued by corporations and governments worldwide, with customers including originators and issuers who utilize these ratings to distribute securities to investors. The segment disseminates ratings via press releases, print, electronic media, and real-time information systems, having rated and monitored approximately 102,000 structured finance obligations. Its research website is accessed by over 185,000 individuals, including 27,000 client users. Moody's Analytics offers credit and economic research, data, analytical tools, risk management software, and financial credentialing services to more than 4,100 institutions globally that use these products to support risk management activities. This segment provides fixed-income valuation and pricing tools to enhance transparency in global markets, particularly for complex structured securities and derivatives. Additionally, it offers research and analytic services allowing customers to replicate monitoring activities conducted by analysts and access raw data, financial statistics, and ratios used in the rating process for municipalities, companies, and financial institutions. The company licenses its databases, software applications, credit risk models, training courses, and publications to customers under fee-bearing agreements.

Expand Energy Corp is an independent exploration and production company that acquires, explores, and develops properties to produce oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGLs) from underground reservoirs in the United States, operating primarily in the Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania, the Haynesville and Bossier Shales in Louisiana, the Eagle Ford Shale and Brazos Valley in Texas, and the Powder River Basin in Wyoming. The company sells these commodities to various purchasers under market-sensitive spot contracts, percentage-of-proceeds contracts, or percentage-of-index contracts, while also providing marketing services to Chesapeake-operated wells that include commodity price structuring, securing gathering, hauling, processing, and transportation services, and contract administration. Valero Energy Corporation is identified as the company's major customer, accounting for approximately 17% of total revenues in 2020, whereas no other single purchaser accounted for more than 10% of revenues. The text contains no information regarding the collection, use, or sharing of customer data.

Simon Property Group, Inc. operates as a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that owns, develops, and manages retail real estate properties. Its portfolio consists primarily of regional malls, Premium Outlets, The Mills, and community/lifestyle centers located in the United States, Europe, Japan, Mexico, and South Korea. The company's customers are retailers who lease space within these properties. The segment does not describe any business involving the collection, use, or sharing of customer data.

Twenty-First Century Fox operates as a diversified global media company with eight industry segments, primarily engaging in the production, acquisition, and distribution of live-action and animated motion pictures, television programming, and cable network content. Its Filmed Entertainment segment produces and distributes films for theatrical release, home media formats, pay-per-view, video-on-demand, and free television networks, while its Television segment produces series for major broadcast networks, cable channels, and specialty networks. The company also manages cable network programming, direct broadcast satellite television, integrated marketing services, newspapers, book publishing, and other operations. Customers include theatrical exhibitors, home media retailers, pay television and pay-per-view providers, video-on-demand services, direct broadcast satellite operators, independent television stations, and basic cable programming services. Twentieth Century Fox Inc. licenses domestic and international television series, films, and sports events to broadcast networks, cable providers, and syndicators, while also selling national advertising units and managing digital sell-through. It owns and operates 27 full-power television stations and 10 MyNetworkTV stations, delivering network programming to approximately 99% of U.S. households, and operates the FOX News Channel and FOX Business Network serving over 98 million and 56 million U.S. households, respectively. The company also owns interests in regional sports networks reaching approximately 84 million subscribers. Its diverse portfolio of domestic and international cable networks offers original series, acquired content, theatrical motion pictures, live sports coverage, and high-definition programming to subscribers across the United States, Mexico, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. Additionally, the company operates a segment producing free-standing inserts and in-store marketing products for consumer packaged goods companies and retailers, reaching over 152 million consumers weekly via its SmartSource brand, while its newspaper and information services segment includes News International, News Limited, Dow Jones, and The New York Post. The book publishing business sells titles to readers, while digital media businesses like MySpace, IGN, and FAN generate revenue through internet advertising, sponsorships, subscriptions, and e-commerce by serving internet audiences and marketers. News Outdoor operates outdoor advertising in Eastern Europe, and other operations include mobile entertainment distribution to consumers in over 15 territories and ownership interests in television stations in Turkey and Israel. The company collects and uses online behavioral data to serve targeted advertising, though it remains unclear how government regulation of such data collection will affect its business.
